answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in inlet, verified in vault, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the velvet check. A farm of 1969 identities would post 3442 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
